name: rust-kv
description: rkv (Rust, hydo-assert SDK); every acknowledged PUT must survive kills and power cuts.

workload.run:
i=$HYDO_FROM
while [ $i -lt $HYDO_TO ]; do
  if /bin/rkv put 7070 k:$i v$i > /dev/null; then echo $i >> $HYDO_ACKED; echo "$i ack" >> $HYDO_OUTCOMES
  else echo "$i unknown" >> $HYDO_OUTCOMES; fi
  i=$((i + 1))
done

invariants.msg: every PUT the client saw acknowledged reads back with its value (rkv check)
